# IlmAI Store

IlmAI Store (https://ilmai.store) is the official store of the IlmAI education platform (https://ilmai.study).

Public commerce pages:
- https://ilmai.store/store
- https://ilmai.store/store/ilm-ai-notes
- https://ilmai.store/sitemap.xml

For individual products, use the canonical /store/{slug} page linked from the public catalog and sitemap. Account, checkout, order, admin, and API routes are not public catalog sources.
